# KashCake

> KashCake is a free, open-source Android app for birthday and anniversary reminders from your contacts. It has no internet access, never changes contacts, and collects nothing. Made by OneKash Labs (https://onekash.org).

Website: https://kashcake.onekash.org
Source: https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashCake
Get it: the Google Play beta (https://kashcake.onekash.org/beta/) or GitHub Releases (https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashCake/releases).

## What it does

- Reads the birthdays and anniversaries in your contacts, lists them by date, and reminds you before each one. A date changed in Contacts updates in KashCake, even while it's closed.
- Birthdays and anniversaries have one switch each. Turning one off removes its dates and reminders after you confirm.
- Reminders on the day, 1 day, 2 days, or 1 week before at 9 AM, or any day up to 30 before at any time.
- "Turning 40" when the birth year is known; a Milestone badge for a first birthday or anniversary, 18, 21, every tenth birthday, and every fifth anniversary.
- Wishes by message, email, or any app that shares text.
- Search by name, or show only birthdays or only anniversaries.
- A home-screen widget with the next Cake Days.
- The name under the icon: KashCake, Cake Days, Birthdays, or Celebrations.
- Edit in Contacts: fix a date in the Contacts app from KashCake.

## Privacy

- No internet permission: no account, ads, analytics, or tracking.
- Read only: it never adds, changes, or deletes contacts.
- Its data is left out of Android backup and device transfer. A new phone imports again from Contacts.
- Lock screen: reminders follow Android's lock-screen setting. With a screen lock and sensitive content hidden, they show no names.

## Requirements

- Android 12 or later.
- Contacts permission to import dates.
- Notification permission for reminders (Android 13 and later).

## Verify your download

The APK signing certificate SHA-256 is E9:60:00:6A:09:F5:9A:A5:1F:F4:EE:E8:C7:D8:0F:DA:C8:71:A2:12:83:28:F2:73:61:CD:AA:66:92:34:EA:D0. App stores that sign builds themselves use their own key.
